contract_tuple: C = (S, K, W, Q, P, M)

W.description: Windowing, chronology, warm-up, and valid-event policy
W.seed_row_policy: Two preceding raw rows initialize lag features and the causal humidity state; they are excluded from the chronological Rolling-24 sample count and from reported-event counts.
W.rolling_cardinality_rule: For W=24, stride=1, and n=24 valid events, 47 chronological samples are required: W + (n - 1).
W.valid_event_definition: A chronologically aligned inference event evaluated only after a complete 24-step window is available.

Q.description: Tensor shape, dtype, and conversion contract

P.description: Preprocessing, residual semantics, output mapping, and reconstruction contract
P.humidity_preprocessing_order: Apply the causal EMA to raw H_in using the W parameters before constructing H_in lag features.
P.lag_policy: Construct lag-1 and lag-2 features after humidity smoothing and preserve chronological sample order.
P.input_clipping: Clip each feature to the frozen per-feature X_MIN/X_MAX bounds before scaling.
P.input_scaling: Per-feature MinMax scaling to [0, 1] using the frozen K constants
P.target_form: Residual targets for T_in and H_in
P.reconstruction: Inverse-scale the residual outputs, then compute T_in = T_in_lag1 + delta_T_in and H_in = H_in_lag1 + delta_H_in.

M.description: Validation metrics, valid-event aggregation, rounding, and stage decision rules
M.event_inclusion_policy: Only complete-window, post-warm-up valid events are included in conformance counts and Rolling-24 metric aggregation.

stage_tolerances.policy_note: Fixed values are applied uniformly across models and targets. Workbook calibration sheets report observed deviations but do not overwrite the adopted pass/fail thresholds.
